Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 400e15d277c7fb7c9e27aa1c203de282e0c51c4f for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-fly-budget-leaf, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-fly-budget-leaf <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-fly-budget-leaf; that second push is the return signal. Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Fixer for PR #2591 (branch fix/r10-fly-budget-leaf, group R10-FLY-BUDGET-LEAF) at head 400e15d277c7fb7c9e27aa1c203de282e0c51c4f. The latest review verdict on origin/review/2591 is blocked. Its first line, verbatim:
